verdict.rationale: Gladia documents an official first-party MCP server, which lets users operate Gladia through natural-language requests in an AI assistant. The evidence is only a probe noting that the MCP docs page exists. There is no detail on which operations are exposed, and no native natural-language command interface: the CLI takes structured commands, and LLM features act on audio content rather than on controlling the product. Missing for 10: documented MCP tool coverage, a native natural-language command interface, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
